title: Run50 #第1州番外｜肯塔基#4：德比马拉松｜三个奖牌，一块蛋糕，我的第50场马拉松！
intro: 工作后的第一场德比马拉松，也是个人第50场全马：周五 5K、周六全马、三块奖牌和一块蛋糕。

blocks.title: 主场第五次，工作后第一次
blocks.label: 前言

blocks.html: 这场比赛对我来说，意义不一般。
这是我 工作后的第一场德比马拉松；

blocks.alt: Friday 5K runners gathering in Iroquois Park
blocks.caption: 周五 5K 起点 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 也是我在 Louisville 主场的第5次 Derby Marathon；

blocks.alt: Siqi smiling through the Friday night 5K
blocks.caption: Siqi smiling @Arsenan

blocks.html: 更是我的 第50个马拉松完赛！

blocks.alt: Big Four Bridge at dusk during the 5K
blocks.caption: 雨中的大桥 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 五年博士 过渡到 工作第一年，

blocks.alt: Ohio River sunset from the bridge
blocks.caption: 俄亥俄河落日 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 感觉整个人生的章节都在赛道上衔接起来了。

blocks.alt: Runners crossing the Big Four Bridge
blocks.caption: 雨中的大桥 · 2 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 今年的德比马拉松有一些不同，主办方还在赛前安排了一个 Derby Festival 5K，

blocks.alt: Video call on the bridge during the 5K
blocks.caption: 桥上风景 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 我没忍住，直接报了名。

blocks.alt: Louisville bridges glowing at sunset
blocks.caption: 落日时分 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 于是，一个周末，跑两场，拿三块奖牌！

blocks.alt: Wet bridge deck reflecting the sunset
blocks.caption: 雨中的大桥 · 3 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 坐了一夜的飞机，从洛杉矶长滩的 WQA 会议回来。

blocks.alt: Mile 3 sign in the 5K rain
blocks.caption: 英里牌 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 刚落地不久，周五晚上就是德比马拉松今年新开的 5 公里比赛。

blocks.alt: Friday 5K selfie with a runner friend
blocks.caption: 周五 5K 起点 · 2 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 比赛前，一场突如其来的大雨让赛事推迟了半个小时。

blocks.alt: After the 5K in the park crowd
blocks.caption: After the @Arsenan

blocks.html: 雨停后，空气变得很干净，带着一点凉意。

blocks.alt: Runners passing a church near downtown
blocks.caption: 赛道跑者 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 下过雨的路易斯维尔天空很好看，云彩很有气势，

blocks.alt: Post-5K medal pose in the rain
blocks.caption: 街角奖牌照 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 特别是配上黄昏的滤镜，更是显得磅礴
5 公里的赛道从市区出发，跑上大四桥，跨过俄亥俄河进入印第安纳州，再折返回到起点。

blocks.alt: Derby Festival fair lights after sunset
blocks.caption: 落日公路 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 桥上的风不大，云却压得很低，城市天际线在远处静静地亮着。

blocks.alt: 5K medal held against the sunset
blocks.caption: 奖牌照 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 这是我第一次在傍晚跑跨州的比赛，挺有意思。

blocks.alt: Group photo after the Friday 5K
blocks.caption: 周五 5K 起点 · 3 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 跑到印第安纳那一段，我妈打来电话。

blocks.alt: Downtown Louisville at the marathon start
blocks.caption: 起点现场 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 我一边跑一边和她视频，5公里，本来就可以不紧不慢，

blocks.alt: Official photo with friends in orange
blocks.caption: with friends · 赛事摄影

blocks.html: 快到终点时，遇到了我的印度朋友 Ranga。

blocks.alt: Official photo from the early race miles
blocks.caption: 前半程赛照 · 赛事摄影

blocks.html: 这场比赛是我推荐他报名的，最后我们一起冲线，虽说我还是快那么一丢丢。

blocks.alt: Official photo with the whole running crew
blocks.caption: 队伍中奔跑 · 赛事摄影

blocks.html: 终点附近的人群热烈而松散。

blocks.alt: Siqi cheering in the downtown crowd
blocks.caption: 城市街景 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 我还在现场遇到了跑步播客 Back of the Pack 的 Kyle Walker。

blocks.alt: Selfie in the first downtown miles
blocks.caption: 路上自拍 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 他戴着五彩的头巾，挂着奖牌，站在人群中很显眼。

blocks.alt: Old Louisville brick buildings on the route
blocks.caption: Old Louisville @Arsenan

blocks.html: 夜色渐渐暗下来，天空被晚霞染成深橘色。

blocks.alt: Runners packed on the early streets
blocks.caption: 路上跑者 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 我举起刚拿到的 5K 奖牌，它的齿轮边缘映着余晖。

blocks.alt: Mile 1 marker on a wet Louisville morning
blocks.caption: 里程标识 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 这场小比赛算是一次热身，第二天，我将迎来自己的第 50 场马拉松。

blocks.title: 穿城而过：波本街、红砖房与赛马场
blocks.label: 穿过市区

blocks.html: 第二天是正赛。公司组了个“小分队”，一组接力队，还有几个跑半马的同事。

blocks.alt: Crowd moving through the neighborhood
blocks.caption: Crowd moving @Arsenan

blocks.html: 大家在起点集合，拍了合照。天气阴沉但凉爽，适合跑步。

blocks.alt: Runner in a Derby-patterned vest
blocks.caption: 转弯跑者 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 这次路线和 2024 年几乎一样，从 Downtown 出发，沿着 Main Street 向西，经过 Old Louisville 和路易斯维尔大学校园，

blocks.alt: Mile 3 sign near the brick warehouse
blocks.caption: 路边英里牌 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 穿过 Churchill Downs 赛马场，一直延伸到 Iroquois Park，然后折返回市中心。

blocks.alt: Russell Proud banner over the course
blocks.caption: Russell Proud @Arsenan

blocks.html: 一开始就经过 Whiskey Row，两边是老式红砖波本酒厂。Old Forester 的铜色招牌特别醒目，空气里能闻到一点酒香。

blocks.alt: Water cups scattered after the aid station
blocks.caption: 补给站 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 再往前是金色的 David 雕像，接着是那根立在 Louisville Slugger 博物馆门口的巨大球棒，地标感很强。

blocks.alt: Runners turning through downtown streets
blocks.caption: 队伍中段 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 我出发晚了几分钟，前面人挺多，但没多久就追上了 Siqi。

blocks.alt: 赛道节奏 · 赛事官方
blocks.caption: 赛道节奏 · 赛事官方

blocks.html: 然后超过了 Ryan，他今年带着新的 Pocket 3，边跑边拍，每年他都有新装备，倒也成了传统。

blocks.alt: Cow-print tutu on the neighborhood stretch
blocks.caption: Cow print @Arsenan

blocks.html: 路线随后转入 Old Louisville，两旁是十九世纪的维多利亚式房子，窗框花纹很细。

blocks.alt: Mile 5 marker in Old Louisville
blocks.caption: 后半程英里牌 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 我在这一段遇到了 Jackie 和 Scott，简单打了个招呼，就各自继续前进了。

blocks.alt: Runner friend throwing arms wide
blocks.caption: 赛道跑者 · 赛事摄影

blocks.html: 再往前是 University of Louisville 校园。这次回来，我已经是校友了。熟悉的红色立柱、草坪和体育馆，变化不大。

blocks.alt: Tattooed spectator greeting runners
blocks.caption: 赛道跑者 · 6 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 从这里开始，选手们的配速拉开，赛道也宽了。

blocks.alt: Red relay shirt on the quiet street
blocks.caption: 街角一幕 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 接着是亮点 Churchill Downs。这是肯塔基德比的主场地，跑道经过外圈，能看到标志性的双尖塔屋顶。

blocks.alt: Mile 7 marker by the trees
blocks.caption: 关键里程 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 空气里混着泥土味和草的气息，远处还能听到训练马的脚步声。
出了赛马场，半马和全马开始分流。左边折返的是半程，右边继续向南的是全程。

blocks.alt: Long red arcade under Churchill Downs
blocks.caption: 山路风景 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 跑步的人少了许多，赛道也安静了下来。

blocks.alt: Churchill Downs crowd behind the fence
blocks.caption: 山路转弯 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 没多大会儿，就进了 Iroquois Park。这段坡不少，但林子密、空气好，脚步也轻快了起来。

blocks.alt: Horse-track walkway inside Churchill Downs
blocks.caption: 山顶视野 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 跑到半程的位置，看到了公司的接力小队。

blocks.alt: Entering the Churchill Downs grandstand
blocks.caption: 林间山路 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 我超过了 Allison，她是公司 HR，活力十足，平时还带足球队。她看到我，举着接力棒冲我笑，喊了句：“Go ZZ！”

blocks.alt: Barbaro statue in front of the grandstand
blocks.caption: Barbaro statue @Arsenan

blocks.html: 主场就是这样，到处都是熟面孔。

blocks.alt: Tunnel miles under Churchill Downs
blocks.caption: 下坡路段 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 出了公园没多久，又遇见了 Annie，韩国女孩，在工业设计组。她的英语发音很干净，听起来像是从小在美国长大的。

blocks.alt: Scoreboard beyond the infield turn
blocks.caption: 田野风景 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 可惜我们刚混熟，比赛结束一个月她就离职了。短短几次聊天，总觉得挺可惜的。

blocks.alt: 赛道跑者 · 7 · 赛事官方
blocks.caption: 赛道跑者 · 7 · 赛事官方

blocks.html: 折返到 路易斯维尔大学 附近，看到了 Seth，他是空调项目组的跑步大神，正等着接棒跑接力段。

blocks.alt: Official photo with Churchill Downs behind
blocks.caption: 路易斯维尔赛照 · 赛事摄影

blocks.html: 我想Alli和Annie应该是帮我争取了足够的时间，Seth想超过应该没那么容易！

blocks.alt: Official orange-shirt photo near the track
blocks.caption: Official orange · 赛事摄影

blocks.html: 接着遇到 Mani，印度朋友，贼能跑，之前我们在路大一个楼层办公。

blocks.alt: Mile 9 marker in the neighborhoods
blocks.caption: 英里牌 · 6 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 他边跑边喊：“Arsen, keep going！” 我俩击了个掌。

blocks.alt: Front-yard band cheering on the course
blocks.caption: Front yard @Arsenan

blocks.html: 紧接着是 Cindy，她像我的美国母亲一样，总在赛道边喊我加油。每次见到她，都很亲切。

blocks.alt: Mile 12 sign before the park hills
blocks.caption: 英里牌 · 7 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 不知不觉快到 20 英里了。
在 24 英里的折返点，看见了 杨黎老师。他步伐稳，表情轻松，我心想这次他又要破四了。

blocks.alt: Official solo shot in the orange kit
blocks.caption: Official solo · 赛事摄影

blocks.html: 然后在终点前我还是被 Seth 反超了，我还想挣扎一下，但他实在太快，只能看他越跑越远。

blocks.alt: High five on the park road
blocks.caption: 路上风景 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 最后一段路，街道两旁的观众多了起来。我又遇到 Jackie 和 Scott，他们正并肩往最后的折返跑。

blocks.alt: Mile 15 sign in the green section
blocks.caption: 英里牌 · 8 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 我们互相招手，没多说话，各自坚持。

blocks.alt: High five with two roadside friends
blocks.caption: 路边远景 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 终点的拱门越来越近。我举起手，冲了过去。计时板定格在 4 小时 18 分，实际成绩4小时5分钟左右。

blocks.alt: Neighborhood cheer squad by the road
blocks.caption: 车窗风景 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 主场第五刷，整整第 50 场马拉松，画上句号。

blocks.alt: Mile 17 sign under tree shade
blocks.caption: 英里牌 · 9 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 冲过终点那一刻，公司的同事们已经在等我。

blocks.alt: Cyclists and big houses beside the course
blocks.caption: Cyclists and @Arsenan

blocks.html: 我跟他们一一击掌，气氛挺不错。

blocks.alt: Cardinals mural along the street
blocks.caption: 市中心路口 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 没跑的同事也来了，举着手写的牌子在那儿喊。

blocks.alt: Official photo by the Louisville logo wall
blocks.caption: 路易斯维尔赛照 · 2 · 赛事摄影

blocks.html: 然后他们拿出一个惊喜：

blocks.alt: Selfie with a runner in black
blocks.caption: 路上自拍 · 赛事摄影

blocks.html: 一个写着“Congratulations on your 50th Marathon!”的小蛋糕。

blocks.alt: Mile 19 marker on the urban stretch
blocks.caption: 英里牌 · 10 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 五十场马拉松，我真的跑了不少。

blocks.alt: Selfie with a friend in a yellow cap
blocks.caption: 路上自拍 · 2 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 大家最后一起去吃披萨。到了店里我才想起，还有第三块奖牌没拿，
那是“5K + Full Marathon”组合奖，也算这次的小彩蛋。

blocks.alt: Runners in bright costumes near campus
blocks.caption: 赛道跑者 · 8 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 拿完奖牌，再回到披萨店，算是正好排个酸。

blocks.alt: Orange shirt · 赛事官方
blocks.caption: Orange shirt · 赛事官方

blocks.html: 披萨上铺着火腿，油光发亮，味道不错。

blocks.alt: Official stride shot past the brick houses
blocks.caption: Official stride · 赛事摄影

blocks.html: 同事们边吃边聊天，还热情地向路人介绍：“今天是这哥们儿的第50个马拉松！”

blocks.alt: Mile 21 marker downtown
blocks.caption: 英里牌 · 11 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 旁边一位美国女士笑着说：“I need to buy u a drink!”

blocks.alt: 赛道跑者 · 9 · 赛事官方
blocks.caption: 赛道跑者 · 9 · 赛事官方

blocks.html: 走出餐厅时，路城的天空也放晴了。

blocks.alt: Late downtown miles with the gray sky
blocks.caption: 城市街景 · 赛事摄影

blocks.html: 又是一年的 Kentucky Derby Marathon，

blocks.alt: Mile 22 sign near the aid station
blocks.caption: 补给桌前 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 这次换了身份，也可算是 TMD 毕业了。

blocks.alt: Runner raising a hand on the long road
blocks.caption: 跑者举手瞬间 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 五十场马拉松，半百的数量，吹吹牛b也算有点底气。

blocks.alt: Marathon turn-around sign near the airport
blocks.caption: 折返点标识 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 跑过的城市越来越多，时间也跑在了身后。

blocks.alt: Runners on the quiet mile 25 road
blocks.caption: 英里牌 · 12 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 三十多岁的我，还在路上。

blocks.alt: Mile 25 sign before the last push
blocks.caption: 英里牌 · 13 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 一百场？可不敢乱讲；未来？肯定还会跑滴！

blocks.alt: Underpass shade in the closing miles
blocks.caption: 桥下阴影 @Arsenan

blocks.html: 当然，我也该为了这个小家 “多” 尽点责任了，

blocks.alt: Official photo in the final stretch
blocks.caption: 终点瞬间 · 赛事摄影

blocks.html: 毕竟，我也开始赚钱了嘛！
